metadata.title: fix(security): detect regex timeout support at runtime
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary
- Probe stdlib regex timeout keyword support at runtime instead of inferring from Python version.
- Fall back to the existing soft timeout helper when `re.Pattern.search(..., timeout=...)` is unavailable.

commits.message:
